name: Sigma Advanced Systems Limited
summary: Sigma Advanced Systems Limited, a defence and aerospace company, designs, develops, and manufactures mission-critical platforms, sub-systems, and components. The company provides multi-axis precision machining solutions, including turning and mill turning, multi-axis milling, solid machining, CNC grinding, and water jet cutting solutions; fabrication and assemblies, structures and precision welding, fusion welding, resistance welding, sheet metal details and assemblies, hydraulic press forming, metal manipulation, precision fabricated structures, thermal and acoustic lagging, and thermal conversion solutions; and surface and metal treatments, such as chromic and tartaric anodizing, alocrom, …
